title: Visible Tails: Characterizing Adaptation to Unknown Moments in Heavy-Tailed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2611.12140v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Heavy-tailed bandit learners must tell a poor arm from an arm whose favorable rewards have not yet appeared. We characterize this obstruction through a scale of one-sided visibility conditions on the optimal reward law: the mean hidden in a rare event is at most a constant multiple of a retained central moment. A quantile-trimmed UCB index that is given the visibility constants attains arm-specific moment rates at every exponent, with no lower bound on the exponent. Conversely, every strategy with a fixed exploration budget has polynomial regret on each law that violates the corresponding condition. For the variance benchmark we determine the order of both budget constants in the visibility level. The frontier depends on the largest exponent the benchmark promises, and the resulting classes are strictly nested. The same index has logarithmic expected regret when rewards are integrable, with a coefficient that can be exponential

translated_title: 可见尾部：刻画重尾老虎机中对未知矩的自适应性
translated_abstract: 重尾老虎机学习者必须区分差劲的臂与有利奖励尚未显现的臂。我们通过最优奖励分布上的一系列单边可见性条件来刻画这一障碍：隐藏在稀有事件中的均值至多是某个保留中心矩的常数倍。一个给定可见性常数的分位数修剪UCB指数，在任意指数处都能达到特定于臂的矩速率，且对指数没有下界要求。反之，任何具有固定探索预算的策略，在每个违反相应条件的分布上都会产生多项式遗憾。对于方差基准，我们确定了可见性水平中两个预算常数的阶。该边界取决于基准所承诺的最大指数，且由此得到的分布类是严格嵌套的。当奖励可积时，同一指数具有对数期望遗憾，但其系数可能是指数级的。
tldr: 该论文提出用单边可见性条件刻画重尾老虎机中对未知矩的自适应极限，证明给定可见性常数的分位数修剪UCB指数可在任意指数下达到臂特定的矩速率，而在违反可见性条件的分布上固定探索预算策略必然遭受多项式遗憾。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes adaptation to unknown moments in heavy-tailed bandits through one-sided visibility conditions, showing that a quantile-trimmed UCB index with visibility constants achieves arm-specific moment rates at every exponent, while any fixed exploration-budget strategy incurs polynomial regret on distributions violating these conditions.
